revenue_growth.source: Assumption: decelerating from FY2025 growth of 10.5% (23,769/21,505-1) as the base matures; AI-driven competition risk keeps it fading to 6%.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: held near FY2025 GAAP operating margin of 36.6% (8,706/23,769, 10-K 0000796343-26-000003).

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. effective rate; FY2025 pretax 8,734 vs net income 7,130 implies 18.4% (10-K 0000796343-26-000003).

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 1.31 x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = 10.7% cost of equity; beta = Damodaran Software unlevered cash-corrected 1.248 relevered at industry D/E 0.056; debt weight 5.3% at after-tax cost 3.97% (Damodaran); WACC ~10.3%. Industry D/E used as no share price available.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate and near long-run nominal GDP growth; conservative for a mature software franchise.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt: total debt 6,210 - cash 5,431 - short-term investments 1,164, 10-K 0000796343-26-000003
